title: Ancillary Spend Status Credit in Summit Requalification
content:
The Crestline Summit Loyalty Program credits ancillary spend toward the counted qualifying dollars of the calendar year. The spend is the total of the seat purchases and checked-bag charges paid on the member's tickets in the last twelve months, as those charges are recorded on the tickets under the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter.

| Seat purchases and checked-bag charges in the last twelve months | Status credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 250 USD or more | 300 |
| 75 USD up to less than 250 USD | 150 |
| Less than 75 USD | None |

**Boundary readings (hypothetical totals)**

- 249.99 USD falls in the middle band and adds 150 USD; 250.00 USD adds 300 USD.
- 74.99 USD adds nothing; 75.00 USD adds 150 USD.

**Span.** A charge counts when its service date is fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the tier is set. Charges of other kinds, such as change fees or upgrade purchases, are not part of the total.
